summary.headline: Compliance-policy lifecycle and Microsoft Store app guidance is refreshed
summary.overview: Intune updates compliance policy creation, overview, monitoring, and Microsoft Store app deployment documentation.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current compliance lifecycle references before changing policies, and review Store app deployment guidance before packaging work.

keyChanges.title: Compliance policy creation guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the guide for creating device compliance policies in Intune.

keyChanges.title: Compliance policy monitoring guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The documentation for monitoring device compliance policy results was refreshed.

summary.headline: macOS compliance settings and Configuration Manager privacy guidance are updated
summary.overview: Microsoft updates macOS compliance settings and several Configuration Manager compliance, endpoint-security, and privacy references.
summary.adminImpact: Review macOS compliance and Configuration Manager privacy material before policy or data-handling changes.

keyChanges.title: macOS compliance settings reference is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune macOS compliance settings reference was revised.

keyChanges.title: Configuration Manager compliance privacy guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the security and privacy documentation for Configuration Manager compliance settings.

summary.headline: Linux and Windows custom compliance, EPM, and Cloud PKI references lead the May 25 week
summary.overview: The week refreshes custom compliance settings for Linux and Windows, endpoint-security policies, the Vulnerability Remediation Agent, and Cloud PKI documentation.
summary.adminImpact: Review current compliance and agent documentation before policy or remediation workflow changes.

keyChanges.title: Linux and Windows custom-compliance guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the guide for custom compliance policies and settings for Linux and Windows devices.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent setup guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Security Copilot Vulnerability Remediation Agent overview and setup guide was updated.

summary.headline: Intune targeting-method guide is added alongside policy-migration and BlackBerry MTD updates
summary.overview: Microsoft adds a guide for choosing a targeting method in Intune and updates Settings Catalog migration and BlackBerry Protect Mobile threat-defense connector references.
summary.adminImpact: Use the targeting-method guide to validate assignment design, and review current MTD connector steps before integration changes.

keyChanges.title: Intune targeting-method guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published a guide for choosing the right targeting method in Intune.

keyChanges.title: BlackBerry Protect Mobile MTD connector guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune documentation for connecting the BlackBerry Protect Mobile MTD connector was revised.

summary.headline: Defender security settings for enrolled and unenrolled devices are refreshed
summary.overview: Microsoft updates Intune endpoint-security antivirus guidance, Defender security settings management for unenrolled devices, and Configuration Manager proxy support.
summary.adminImpact: Security teams should verify antivirus and Defender settings-management procedures before modifying policy assignments or coverage.

keyChanges.title: Endpoint-security antivirus guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the guide for managing antivirus settings with Intune endpoint-security policies.

keyChanges.title: Defender settings management for unenrolled devices is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune documentation for managing Defender settings on devices not enrolled with Intune was updated.
